Class CurrencyConverter

java.lang.Object
CurrencyConverter
public class CurrencyConverter extends Object
A command-line application for currency conversion between USD and IDR.

This class provides methods to convert amounts from United States Dollar (USD) to Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) and vice versa, using a fixed exchange rate. It also includes a main method to demonstrate the functionality through a console-based user interface.

      public static void main(String[] args)
      The main method to run the currency converter application.

      It provides a console interface for the user to choose a conversion, enter an amount, and see the result. The program continues to run until the user chooses to exit.

      Parameters:
      args - Command-line arguments (not used).
